---
title: "Cities in Transition"
description: "Comparative Economic Studies, 2012."
date: "2012-01-01"
categories: [other, urban-economics, transition-economies]
---

Post-socialist cities inherited industrial geographies built for central
planning, not markets. This paper tracks how urban economic structure in
transition countries evolved after 1991 — which cities adapted, which
stayed locked into declining industries, and what that implies for
regional policy.

**Published in:** *Comparative Economic Studies*, 54(3), 661–688
